about: Starter EN/ID copy for the customer app, keyed by screen. English is final wording from the design. Indonesian is a first draft: have a native speaker check it before launch. Indonesian runs 20–30% longer; layouts must allow for it. {placeholders} are filled in by the app.

skipCheckOrderPage.en: Skip, I'll check the order page

messageSeller.id: Kirim pesan ke penjual lewat WhatsApp

paused.body.en: {cook} has paused ordering. Check back soon, or message her.
paused.body.id: {cook} sedang menghentikan pesanan. Cek lagi nanti, atau kirim pesan.

closed.body.en: The cut-off was {dateTime}. {cook} may still fit you in.
closed.body.id: Batas pesan {dateTime}. Mungkin {cook} masih bisa menerima.

notOut.body.en: {cook} will share it on WhatsApp when it's ready. Open the same link again then.
notOut.body.id: {cook} akan membagikannya di WhatsApp. Buka tautan yang sama nanti.

error.body.en: Check your internet connection and try again.
error.body.id: Periksa koneksi internet lalu coba lagi.

deliveryNote.en: You'll send your address to the seller on WhatsApp after ordering. It's never stored in the app.
deliveryNote.id: Setelah memesan, kirim alamat Anda ke penjual lewat WhatsApp. Alamat tidak pernah disimpan di aplikasi.

firstName.help.en: Only your first name or a nickname
firstName.help.id: Cukup nama depan atau nama panggilan

note.help.en: Don't write your address or phone number here.
note.help.id: Jangan tulis alamat atau nomor telepon di sini.

changeUntil.en: You can change or cancel until {dateTime}.
changeUntil.id: Anda bisa mengubah atau membatalkan sampai {dateTime}.

err.soldOut.en: {dish} just sold out. We took it out of your basket. Your total is now {total}.
err.soldOut.id: {dish} baru saja habis. Kami keluarkan dari keranjang. Total sekarang {total}.

sendWhatsApp.help.en: Opens WhatsApp with your order already written.
sendWhatsApp.help.id: WhatsApp terbuka dengan pesanan sudah tertulis.

updates.title.en: Get a message when your order is ready

updates.body.en: Takes a minute. Or skip it and check this order page.
updates.body.id: Hanya semenit. Atau lewati dan cek halaman pesanan ini.

qr.body.en: {cook} scans it, or you read out the code.

qr.brightness.en: Turn your screen brightness up for scanning

cancel.confirmBody.en: {cook} will see it's cancelled. You can't undo this.
cancel.confirmBody.id: {cook} akan melihat pesanan dibatalkan. Tidak bisa dikembalikan.

locked.en: The seller has locked this order. Message them on WhatsApp to change it.
locked.id: Penjual sudah mengunci pesanan ini. Kirim pesan lewat WhatsApp untuk mengubahnya.

menuClosed.en: This menu is closed. You can still see what you ordered.
menuClosed.id: Menu ini sudah ditutup. Anda masih bisa melihat pesanan Anda.

keptFor4Weeks.en: Order details are kept for 4 weeks, then removed from this phone.
keptFor4Weeks.id: Detail pesanan disimpan 4 minggu, lalu dihapus dari ponsel ini.

openByCode.en: Have an order code? e.g. K7F-2QX

empty.title.id: Pesanan Anda akan muncul di sini

empty.body.en: After you order, you can follow it from this page.
empty.body.id: Setelah memesan, Anda bisa memantaunya di halaman ini.

footnote.en: Saved on this phone only. No account.
footnote.id: Hanya tersimpan di ponsel ini. Tanpa akun.

ask.title.en: Get a message when your order is ready

ask.body.en: On iPhone, first add Onde Onde to your Home Screen. 4 quick taps, about a minute.
ask.body.id: Di iPhone, tambahkan dulu Onde Onde ke Layar Utama. 4 ketukan, sekitar semenit.

ask.skip.en: Not now, I'll check the order page
ask.skip.id: Nanti saja, saya cek halaman pesanan

step1.body.en: It's at the bottom right of the screen.

step1.older.en: Older iPhone? Tap the Share button instead, then skip to step 3.
step1.older.id: iPhone lama? Ketuk tombol Bagikan, lalu langsung ke langkah 3.

step2.body.en: It's in the menu that just opened.
step2.body.id: Ada di menu yang baru terbuka.

step3.body.en: Don't see it? Tap "More" or scroll down.
step3.body.id: Tidak terlihat? Ketuk "Lainnya" atau gulir ke bawah.

step4.body.en: Top right. Leave "Open as Web App" switched on.
step4.body.id: Di kanan atas. Biarkan "Buka sebagai App Web" tetap menyala.

open.title.en: Now open Onde Onde from your Home Screen
open.title.id: Sekarang buka Onde Onde dari Layar Utama

open.body.en: It opens straight to order {code}. Turn on notifications there.
open.body.id: Langsung terbuka di pesanan {code}. Nyalakan pemberitahuan di sana.

iosInApp.title.en: First, open this page in Safari
iosInApp.title.id: Buka dulu halaman ini di Safari

iosInApp.body.en: You're inside WhatsApp. Order updates only work from Safari on iPhone.
iosInApp.body.id: Anda sedang di dalam WhatsApp. Kabar pesanan hanya bisa lewat Safari di iPhone.

en: Tap the address bar and Paste and Go
id: Ketuk kolom alamat lalu Tempel dan Buka

androidInApp.title.en: First, open this page in Chrome
androidInApp.title.id: Buka dulu halaman ini di Chrome

androidInApp.body.en: You're inside WhatsApp, which can't send order updates.
androidInApp.body.id: Anda sedang di dalam WhatsApp, yang tidak bisa mengirim kabar pesanan.

android.ask.body.en: Tap Allow when your phone asks.

android.install.title.en: Put Onde Onde on your home screen
android.install.title.id: Pasang Onde Onde di layar utama

android.install.body.en: Opens like an app, one tap away.
android.install.body.id: Terbuka seperti aplikasi, cukup sekali ketuk.

android.install.fallback.en: No Install button? Tap ⋮ in Chrome, then Add to home screen.
android.install.fallback.id: Tidak ada tombol Pasang? Ketuk ⋮ di Chrome, lalu Tambahkan ke layar utama.

off.body.en: Your phone will ask. Tap Allow and we'll tell you when order {code} is ready.
off.body.id: Ponsel akan bertanya. Ketuk Izinkan dan kami kabari saat pesanan {code} siap.

on.body.en: We'll tell you when your order is ready.
on.body.id: Kami akan kabari saat pesanan siap.

blocked.body.en: Your phone is set to not show them. You can turn them back on in your iPhone's Settings:
blocked.body.id: Ponsel Anda diatur untuk tidak menampilkannya. Nyalakan lagi di Pengaturan iPhone:

blocked.android.en: On Android: in Chrome tap ⋮, then Settings, Site settings, Notifications, and allow {domain}.
blocked.android.id: Di Android: di Chrome ketuk ⋮, lalu Setelan, Setelan situs, Notifikasi, dan izinkan {domain}.

push.about: Text of the web push notifications. Title is the kitchen name. Tapping opens the order page.

outForDelivery.en: Your order is out for delivery
